verdict.rationale: Bento documents reusable templates managed via API/CLI (create once, reuse across Sequences/Workflows, CLI 'manage templates' command), which supports API-managed templates, but there is no evidence of HTML/MJML source format, explicit variable-substitution syntax, or any git/version-control workflow for templates. Missing for 10: HTML/MJML template authoring, documented variable substitution syntax, and version-control integration or CLI push/pull workflow tied to a repo.
